messages:
mia: quick heads-up — ran a microbench for the paged FlashAttention + fused RoPE path. seeing a sharp tail in p95 when batch_size > 8, seq_len 2048. baseline non-paged flash is fine. :thinking_face:

jonah: can you paste the exact command/profile? was this on the kernel-selection branch?

mia: yup kernel-selection=auto, kernel_override unset. ran on g5. Command: `./bench_attention --model=ggml-rope-fused --flash=paged --bs=16 --seqlen=2048 --kv-page-size=64k`

mia: attaching quick profiler snippet:
```
[perf] attention_forward  0.042s (median)  0.185s (p95)  0.248s (max)
[mem] kv_pages memcpy  7.2ms per request when page boundary crossed
[gpu] kernel_launch latency spiky only on last token chunk
```

sara: interesting. sounds like KV page boundary triggers an extra memcpy + kernel relaunch. did you try setting kv-page-size=256k?

mia: i did. with 256k p95 drops back to ~0.05s. but that increases memory footprint and hurts throughput for short context jobs.

rahul: hypothesis: fused RoPE kernel assumes contiguous KV layout and avoids bounds checks; paged flash path introduces indirections that break the contiguous fast path, so kernel-selection picks the fused kernel but runtime does extra copies when paged mapping misaligns.

jonah: can we reproduce in unit test by forcing an alignment misalign and checking memcpy counts? would help assert regression and add to perf test matrix.

mia: created a small repro (lokal): `tests/attn/repro_paged_rope.sh` — inserts misaligned kv_page_offset and runs perf counters. results: memcpy_count increases x4 for bs>=12.

perf-bot: perf-regression alert: attention_fused_rope_paged (master->kernel-selection) latency +240% p95 on g5 for seqlen=2048, batch=16. See CI link: https://ci.internal/perf/ATTN/2345

sara: ok plan: 1) add explicit kernel guard: if paged_kv && fused_rope && unaligned_pages -> fallback to paged-aware fused kernel (or patched memcpy-less path). 2) add unit test + perf CI case for bs in [8,12,16] x seqlen [512,2048]. 3) consider heuristic in kernel-selector: prefer paged-aware kernels when kv_page_size < seqlen_chunk_threshold.

rahul: +1. also want to test a quick patch: detect misaligned pages and coalesce before calling fused kernel (cheap for small bs). if coalesce cost > benefit -> fallback. can prototype in PR#3491.

mia: creating draft PR with repro, profiler traces, and a naive coalesce fallback. tagging @jonah @sara for review. leaving notes in the PR about memory tradeoffs.

jonah: thanks. can you add a flamegraph snippet to the PR so infra can see where kernel launches spike? also add a benchmark for paged vs non-paged with same kv size so we can quantify tradeoffs.

mia: will do. filing issue #1120 for long-term: kernel-selection should include kv_layout metadata so runtime can pick truly compatible kernels.

perf-bot: comment: schedule extended perf run for PR#3491 on g5-48h.

mia: nice — i'll iterate on the PR today. :thumbsup:
